title: Calibration, Not Accuracy: What Stacking Adds to Gradient Boosting in Credit Risk Scoring (code and benchmark)
description: Reproducible benchmark of a calibrated stacked ensemble against logistic regression, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, TabNet and an FT-Transformer on the South German Credit and Taiwan credit-card default datasets, with repeated nested cross-validation, Nadeau-Bengio paired tests with Holm adjustment, calibration analysis, a group fairness audit and a stylized stress sensitivity. Includes code, a Colab notebook, the results of the reported run, the manuscript source and a script that checks every number in the manuscript against the results.
